notes: Resolver (protocol 6). The assessors agree on I1 (false), I2 to I4 (null), I5 (true) and eligible (false); they disagree only on exclusion_code. Full text read (text layer, all 5 page images; no supplementary files supplied). The paper contains no experimental section and no measurement of any kind by the authors: its own work is a MATLAB digital image-processing and statistics routine applied to TEM images reproduced from other papers (captions 'Fig. 2. TEM image [10].', 'Fig. 4. TEM image [10].', 'Fig. 6. TEM image [12].', 'Fig. 8. TEM image [12].', pp. 1489-1490), giving diameter histograms (Figs. 3, 5, 7, 9). Every H2 storage value is quoted from earlier work in Section 2, e.g. "Ritschel et al. [8] tested different nanotubes samples and reported a value of 0.63 wt% at 300 K and 4.2 MPa for SWNT samples of 90% purity." (main, p. 2 (1488), Section 2 Literature review, left column). I1 therefore fails. The theoretical_only reason in the 4 table is 'Computational or theoretical work with no measured H2 uptake', and the I1 rule maps an I1 failure to theoretical_only 'for computation or theory only'; both describe the paper's work, not whether H2 uptake itself is computed. This paper's work is computation only (image processing and statistical analysis of published micrographs) and it has no measured H2 uptake, so theoretical_only applies, and it precedes no_conditions_stated in the 4 table order, so it is the first applicable code. Assessor B's reading (theoretical_only only for computed or simulated H2 uptake) is not what either the table or the I1 mapping says; no_conditions_stated's own reason ('No uptake value with stated or recoverable T and P') does not describe this paper at all. not_primary does not apply: a research article with its own analysis results, not a review, perspective, thesis, patent or data-free abstract. retracted: record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. duplicate_data: not applicable.
